```python
from griffe import load

# Load the package at v1.0.0 and HEAD using git-aware loading
old = load("mypkg", git_ref="v1.0.0")
new = load("mypkg", git_ref="HEAD")

# Iterate over breaking changes between the two versions
for breakage in old.get_breaking_changes(new):
    print(breakage)
```
